name: Forest
evidence: Original scr/0000 (locmode/folder), scr/2100 (TXT/select/load/audio), and CodeX early command layouts. VM addressing: shared tsc_vm.py and original 0x1800/0x1900/0xa800 sequences.
entryGuide: Create a working copy. The original start path calls 1000; export your scene as 1000.gsc to replace that call target in the copy. Original startup/menu scripts and resources are still required. Never install over the original game.
